race.comment: LOVE STORY (2) well-bred Justify mare who warranted the good support on debut with a tough on-pace second over 1200m at Warwick Farm in a Super Maiden. Tongue-tie goes on and will relish the extra journey. Will take catching. KLOCKE (6) talented colt destined for bigger things this time in. Held his ground to the line on resumption as the $1.35 fav, with a narrow second over 1250m in a Super Maiden at Newcastle. Blinkers go on today and will take stopping over the extra ground. IOMMI (5) has caught the eye in his two runs back and looks to get a much better set-up. Savaged the line from the wide draw when third over 1400m at Rosehill. Can race closer today and play a leading role. IMINASTATE (4) returned with an encouraging fourth over 1250m in a Super Maiden at Newcastle. Well drawn and expected to be in the minor money.
